problem: Opposite sides/angles of proper parallelogram are congruent; DB diagonal divides positive unsigned area in half
litex_code:
# Book I.34: opposite sides and angles, and DB-diagonal equal area halves.
# Formal cyclic ABCD corresponds to source cyclic ACDB; DB is source BC.
thm proposition_34:
    ? forall a, b, c, d cart(R, R):
        $area::is_proper_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
        =>:
            $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(a, b, c, d)
            $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(a, d, b, c)
            $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(d, a, b, b, c, d)
            $geometry::main::are_angles_congruent(a, b, c, c, d, a)
            exist half R+ st {$area::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, half), $area::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, half), $area::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, 2*half)}
    thm local_parallelogram_coordinate_closure:
        ? forall par_a, par_b, par_c, par_d cart(R, R):
            $area::is_proper_parallelogram(par_a, par_b, par_c, par_d)
            =>:
                par_d(1) = par_a(1)+par_c(1)-par_b(1)
                par_d(2) = par_a(2)+par_c(2)-par_b(2)
        thm local_independent_directions_force_zero_offset:
            ? forall u1, u2, v1, v2, k1, k2 R:
                u1*v2-u2*v1 != 0
                u1*k2-u2*k1 = 0
                v1*k2-v2*k1 = 0
                =>:
                    k1 = 0
                    k2 = 0
            have determinant R = u1*v2-u2*v1
            determinant != 0
            determinant*k1 = (u1*v2-u2*v1)*k1 = v1*(u1*k2-u2*k1)-u1*(v1*k2-v2*k1) = v1*0-u1*0 = 0
            determinant*k2 = (u1*v2-u2*v1)*k2 = v2*(u1*k2-u2*k1)-u2*(v1*k2-v2*k1) = v2*0-u2*0 = 0
            k1 = (determinant*k1)/determinant = 0/determinant = 0
            k2 = (determinant*k2)/determinant = 0/determinant = 0
        by def $area::is_proper_parallelogram(par_a, par_b, par_c, par_d)
        by def $parallel::are_parallel_lines(par_a, par_b, par_d, par_c)
        by def $parallel::are_parallel_lines(par_a, par_d, par_b, par_c)
        by def $geometry::main::is_parallel(par_a, par_b, par_d, par_c)
        by def $geometry::main::is_parallel(par_a, par_d, par_b, par_c)
        have u1 R = par_b(1)-par_a(1)
        have u2 R = par_b(2)-par_a(2)
        have v1 R = par_d(1)-par_a(1)
        have v2 R = par_d(2)-par_a(2)
        have k1 R = par_a(1)+par_c(1)-par_b(1)-par_d(1)
        have k2 R = par_a(2)+par_c(2)-par_b(2)-par_d(2)
        release thm geometry::main::collinear_det_expand(par_a, par_b, par_d)
        u1*v2-u2*v1 = (par_b(1)-par_a(1))*(par_d(2)-par_a(2))-(par_b(2)-par_a(2))*(par_d(1)-par_a(1)) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(par_a, par_b), geometry::main::vec(par_a, par_d)) != 0
        release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(par_a, par_b)
        release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(par_a, par_d)
        release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(par_d, par_c)
        release thm geometry::main::vec_coordinate_formula(par_b, par_c)
        release thm geometry::main::det_coordinate_formula(geometry::main::vec(par_a, par_b), geometry::main::vec(par_d, par_c))
        release thm geometry::main::det_coordinate_formula(geometry::main::vec(par_a, par_d), geometry::main::vec(par_b, par_c))
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(par_a, par_b), geometry::main::vec(par_d, par_c)) = (par_b(1)-par_a(1))*(par_c(2)-par_d(2))-(par_b(2)-par_a(2))*(par_c(1)-par_d(1))
        (par_b(1)-par_a(1))*(par_c(2)-par_d(2))-(par_b(2)-par_a(2))*(par_c(1)-par_d(1)) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(par_a, par_b), geometry::main::vec(par_d, par_c)) = 0
        geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(par_a, par_d), geometry::main::vec(par_b, par_c)) = (par_d(1)-par_a(1))*(par_c(2)-par_b(2))-(par_d(2)-par_a(2))*(par_c(1)-par_b(1))
        (par_d(1)-par_a(1))*(par_c(2)-par_b(2))-(par_d(2)-par_a(2))*(par_c(1)-par_b(1)) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(par_a, par_d), geometry::main::vec(par_b, par_c)) = 0
        u1*k2-u2*k1 = (par_b(1)-par_a(1))*(par_a(2)+par_c(2)-par_b(2)-par_d(2))-(par_b(2)-par_a(2))*(par_a(1)+par_c(1)-par_b(1)-par_d(1)) = (par_b(1)-par_a(1))*(par_c(2)-par_d(2))-(par_b(2)-par_a(2))*(par_c(1)-par_d(1)) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(par_a, par_b), geometry::main::vec(par_d, par_c)) = 0
        v1*k2-v2*k1 = (par_d(1)-par_a(1))*(par_a(2)+par_c(2)-par_b(2)-par_d(2))-(par_d(2)-par_a(2))*(par_a(1)+par_c(1)-par_b(1)-par_d(1)) = (par_d(1)-par_a(1))*(par_c(2)-par_b(2))-(par_d(2)-par_a(2))*(par_c(1)-par_b(1)) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(par_a, par_d), geometry::main::vec(par_b, par_c)) = 0
        release thm local_independent_directions_force_zero_offset(u1, u2, v1, v2, k1, k2)
        par_a(1)+par_c(1)-par_b(1) = (par_a(1)+par_c(1)-par_b(1)-par_d(1))+par_d(1) = k1+par_d(1) = 0+par_d(1) = par_d(1)
        par_a(2)+par_c(2)-par_b(2) = (par_a(2)+par_c(2)-par_b(2)-par_d(2))+par_d(2) = k2+par_d(2) = 0+par_d(2) = par_d(2)
    by def $area::is_proper_parallelogram(a, b, c, d)
    by def $parallel::are_parallel_lines(a, b, d, c)
    by def $parallel::are_parallel_lines(a, d, b, c)
    release thm local_parallelogram_coordinate_closure(a, b, c, d)
    a(1)+c(1)-d(1) = a(1)+c(1)-(a(1)+c(1)-b(1)) = b(1)
    a(2)+c(2)-d(2) = a(2)+c(2)-(a(2)+c(2)-b(2)) = b(2)
    release thm geometry::main::parallelogram_sides(a, b, c, d)
    release thm geometry::main::parallelogram_sides(a, d, c, b)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_symmetric(a, b)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_symmetric(a, d)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_symmetric(b, c)
    release thm geometry::main::distance_sq_symmetric(c, d)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b) = geometry::main::distance_sq(d, c) = geometry::main::distance_sq(c, d)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(a, d) = geometry::main::distance_sq(b, c)
    by def $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(a, b, c, d)
    by def $geometry::main::are_segments_congruent(a, d, b, c)
    d(1)-a(1) = (a(1)+c(1)-b(1))-a(1) = c(1)-b(1)
    b(1)-c(1) = -(c(1)-b(1)) = -(d(1)-a(1))
    d(1)-c(1) = (a(1)+c(1)-b(1))-c(1) = a(1)-b(1) = -(b(1)-a(1))
    c(1)-d(1) = -(d(1)-c(1)) = -(a(1)-b(1))
    a(1)-d(1) = -(d(1)-a(1)) = -(c(1)-b(1))
    d(2)-a(2) = (a(2)+c(2)-b(2))-a(2) = c(2)-b(2)
    b(2)-c(2) = -(c(2)-b(2)) = -(d(2)-a(2))
    d(2)-c(2) = (a(2)+c(2)-b(2))-c(2) = a(2)-b(2) = -(b(2)-a(2))
    c(2)-d(2) = -(d(2)-c(2)) = -(a(2)-b(2))
    a(2)-d(2) = -(d(2)-a(2)) = -(c(2)-b(2))
    release thm geometry::main::perpendicular_dot_expand(c, b, c, d)
    release thm geometry::main::perpendicular_dot_expand(a, d, a, b)
    geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(c, b), geometry::main::vec(c, d)) = (b(1)-c(1))*(d(1)-c(1))+(b(2)-c(2))*(d(2)-c(2)) = (-(d(1)-a(1)))*(-(b(1)-a(1)))+(-(d(2)-a(2)))*(-(b(2)-a(2))) = (d(1)-a(1))*(b(1)-a(1))+(d(2)-a(2))*(b(2)-a(2)) = geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(a, d), geometry::main::vec(a, b))
    geometry::main::distance_sq(a, d) = geometry::main::distance_sq(b, c) = geometry::main::distance_sq(c, b)
    release thm geometry_lemmas::angle_congruence_from_equal_sides_and_dot(a, d, b, c, b, d)
    release thm geometry::main::perpendicular_dot_expand(d, c, d, a)
    release thm geometry::main::perpendicular_dot_expand(b, a, b, c)
    geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(d, c), geometry::main::vec(d, a)) = (c(1)-d(1))*(a(1)-d(1))+(c(2)-d(2))*(a(2)-d(2)) = (-(a(1)-b(1)))*(-(c(1)-b(1)))+(-(a(2)-b(2)))*(-(c(2)-b(2))) = (a(1)-b(1))*(c(1)-b(1))+(a(2)-b(2))*(c(2)-b(2)) = geometry::main::dot(geometry::main::vec(b, a), geometry::main::vec(b, c))
    geometry::main::distance_sq(b, a) = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, b) = geometry::main::distance_sq(c, d) = geometry::main::distance_sq(d, c)
    geometry::main::distance_sq(b, c) = geometry::main::distance_sq(a, d) = geometry::main::distance_sq(d, a)
    release thm geometry_lemmas::angle_congruence_from_equal_sides_and_dot(b, a, c, d, c, a)
    release thm geometry::main::collinear_det_expand(a, b, d)
    release thm geometry::main::collinear_det_expand(b, c, d)
    d(1)-b(1) = (d(1)-a(1))-(b(1)-a(1))
    d(2)-b(2) = (d(2)-a(2))-(b(2)-a(2))
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, c), geometry::main::vec(b, d)) = (c(1)-b(1))*(d(2)-b(2))-(c(2)-b(2))*(d(1)-b(1)) = (d(1)-a(1))*((d(2)-a(2))-(b(2)-a(2)))-(d(2)-a(2))*((d(1)-a(1))-(b(1)-a(1))) = (b(1)-a(1))*(d(2)-a(2))-(b(2)-a(2))*(d(1)-a(1)) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, d))
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, c), geometry::main::vec(b, d)) = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, d)) != 0
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(a, b, d)
    by def $geometry::main::is_triangle(b, c, d)
    have half R+ = area::triangle_area(a, b, d)
    $area::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, half)
    by def $area::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, half)
    geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, d))^2 = geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, c), geometry::main::vec(b, d))^2
    2*half = sqrt(geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(a, b), geometry::main::vec(a, d))^2) = sqrt(geometry::main::det(geometry::main::vec(b, c), geometry::main::vec(b, d))^2)
    by def $area::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, half)
    witness exist first, second R+ st {$area::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, first), $area::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, second), 2*half = first+second} from half, half
    by def $area::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, 2*half)
    witness exist common R+ st {$area::has_triangle_area(a, b, d, common), $area::has_triangle_area(b, c, d, common), $area::has_parallelogram_area(a, b, c, d, 2*common)} from half
